maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from new PX pressure exchanger sales for new desalination and wastewater plants, plus some retrofits and aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly plant builders, OEMs and private operators of desalination and industrial wastewater plants, though some end owners are municipal.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own proprietary PX technology into desalination, wastewater and new applications, not through a stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: PX devices are engineered into plants' high-pressure systems; switching means redesign, requalification and downtime.

notes: Publicly funded is uncertain because many desalination plants are municipal or state-owned, but buyers are mostly private firms.
